material_passport.search_boundary: search-bounded through 2026-07-22; not an absolute novelty proof

prohibited_claims: first to use hierarchy in generative recommendation
first to add a ranking loss to generative recommendation
first to mine beam-search hard negatives
first popularity-aware objective for semantic-ID recommendation
first to rerank generative beam candidates
surviving_candidate_claim: A lightweight supervised objective for lexical-hierarchical generative recommendation that mines the current student's miss@10/hit@50 beam errors and jointly conditions positive-negative sequence-likelihood margins on semantic-prefix confusion depth and training-only target popularity.
required_strong_controls: LOHRec-style ordered-prior ranking control where feasible
item-score reranking control or explicit comparison to Gryphon/RecoChain
evidence_limits: Several 2026 works are arXiv preprints rather than peer-reviewed publications.
The audit is search-bounded and cannot establish absolute novelty.
A combination-level distinction is not sufficient by itself; B1/S2 must show mechanism-specific gains over component controls.
